shell_err_locked_cmd: This command is not available in this mission: {cmd}
puzzle_match_title: Connect the pairs (tap left, then right)
puzzle_password_title: Build the password from the clues
puzzle_codefix_title: Tap the wrong line and pick a replacement
mission_broken: This mission can't be opened right now
m1_01_brief_1: Hi, rookie. I'm Ghost. Your first job is an easy one.
m1_01_brief_2: There's a welcome note on the cafe PC down the street. Find it with scan, get in with connect, read it with open.
m1_01_done_1: Good. Three commands and you can go anywhere. The next one gets more interesting.
m1_01_f_readme: My laptop. To do: try connecting to the cafe PC.
m1_01_f_welcome: Welcome! You just connected to your first server.
m1_01_hint_1: Tap scan first to find nearby servers.
m1_01_hint_2: Tap connect, then tap the server name chip.
m1_02_brief_1: A friend forgot the password to their vault server. They left a note, but wrote it in code.
m1_02_brief_2: Read the note on my laptop and crack the coded file with decode. Then use that password to get into vault-box.
m1_02_done_1: One decode and the code falls apart. Your friend is bad at security. On to the next job.
m1_02_f_note: The password is in secret.txt, but I shifted every letter three places. The decode command should undo it.
m1_02_f_key: Vault key number: 4417. Please pass it to my friend.
m1_02_hint_1: Read note.txt first. It says which file to decode.
m1_02_hint_2: Tap decode and pick secret.txt to reveal the real password.
m1_02_hint_3: Run connect vault-box, then type the decoded word exactly.
m1_03_brief_1: The router admin page is locked. It only opens once the back-panel ports are wired correctly.
m1_03_brief_2: My laptop note says what plugs into each port. Match them up exactly.
m1_03_done_1: Wiring sorted. The admin note is yours now.
m1_03_f_note: Router back panel: PWR takes the 5V adapter, LAN1 the 192.168.0.2 desktop, WAN the ISP line, USB the mouse.
m1_03_f_admin: Admin note: change the router password next week.
m1_03_hint_1: note.txt lists what connects to each port.
m1_03_hint_2: connect router opens the wiring puzzle. Tap a left port, then its partner on the right.
m1_03_hint_3: PWR→5V, LAN1→192.168.0.2, WAN→ISP, USB→mouse, then open admin.txt.
m1_04_brief_1: A cloud drive is locked and its owner can't remember the password. Luckily there are clues.
m1_04_brief_2: People usually mix a pet's name with a year. Check the photo note on my laptop.
m1_04_done_1: A pet's name, of course. People make the same mistake every time.
m1_04_f_photo: Note on the back of a photo: our cat Momo (momo). We brought her home in spring 2019.
m1_04_f_diary: Diary: Finally got back into the drive. I'll write the password down this time.
m1_04_p1_c1: The cat's name, in lowercase English.
m1_04_p1_c2: Then the year she came home, in four digits.
m1_04_hint_1: photo.txt has the cat's name and the year.
m1_04_hint_2: connect cloud-drive opens the build puzzle. Tap the name piece, then the year piece.
m1_05_brief_1: An old server won't start. It's an antique that needs its boot order set by hand.
m1_05_brief_2: I put the manual on my laptop. Drag the steps into order and it should come alive.
m1_05_done_1: The antique lives. Good job grabbing the backup file.
m1_05_f_manual: Old server boot order: 1) power on 2) load the BIOS 3) start the OS 4) log in.
m1_05_f_backup: Backup list: 1,204 photos, 88 documents. All safe.
m1_05_hint_1: manual.txt lists the boot order by number.
m1_05_hint_2: connect old-server opens the order puzzle. Long-press an item and drag it.
m1_05_hint_3: Power on → Load BIOS → Start OS → Login, then open backup.txt.
m1_06_brief_1: This one is a real request. Before she passed, a grandmother left a gift for her grandson on a safe server.
m1_06_brief_2: You need the mail server first to learn how to open the safe. The mail password is coded on my laptop.
m1_06_brief_3: There are two servers, so if you get lost, use back. Use everything you've learned.
m1_06_done_1: The grandson got his gift. That's the end of your first chapter.
m1_06_done_2: From now on, no more toy commands. Real ones. Get ready.
m1_06_f_note: Mail server password is in hint.txt, each letter shifted by one. How to open the safe is in the mail.
m1_06_f_letter: To my grandson. Set the color locks: red to A, blue to C, green to B. To open it, turn the key first, open the lid, then take the gift.
m1_06_f_prize: The gift: a map to the tree Grandma planted in your name.
m1_06_hint_1: Read note.txt and decode hint.txt. That's the mail-box password.
m1_06_hint_2: letter.txt on mail-box has the color pairs and the safe's opening order.
m1_06_hint_3: red→A, blue→C, green→B. Then Turn key → Open lid → Take prize.
title_tagline: Every server has a back door
